lines: Who in every way having abandoned dependence on other but standing from own; from faith who even and from Ācārya faith indeed from only.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yaḥ sarvathā parāpekṣāmujjhitvā tu sthito nijāt pratyayādyo@pi cācāryapratyayādeva kevalāt
